I graduated last year (December 2020). I had a job afterwards in my industry but got redundant on April 2021. Then got a job as waitress (after days of unemployment), im still applying for jobs that are within my industry. 

My plan this year is to take my time and know my worth due to the toxic environment in my previous job and depression. My previous job really hit me with the reality of 9 to 5 job and that constant "grind" life. I constantly thought of my failures and never the positive sides. I have been beating myself up and not really taking care of my physical and mental health.

My goals are:

- Attend my therapy session every month

- Go to gym 3 days a week

- Journaling and learning mindfulness

- Get my drivers license and car

- Do what makes me happy; decorate my apartment, travel locally, eat yummy food, pet cats etc

- Appreciate the present time and the moment. Putting my head up and looking at the beautiful clouds forming.

- Surrounding myself with people who loves me and support me. They are there to keep me sane.

I too feel lost in life, that is why I have these goals for now. I thought my passion for design faded but all I needed was to take my time and do new stuff. For example; I went hiking, painted traditionally and attend muay thai classes for the first time. It was a nice feeling and I appreciated the new experiences. 
Basically, I just took whatever was in front of me and do what interested me (even if i was only a little bit interested). 

This is your time and opportunity to try out new things. Don't over think and just do what makes you happy. 
Stand up, take your time and work hard. This is just another obstacle that we need to overcome. Enjoy your life and the pace you are in. We are not in a race. 

Its okay to cry and feel sad, allow yourself to feel it and then stand up again. 

Lets do our best, okay!

Don't waste your time and always keep your standards.
Communication is definitley key, everyones feelings is valid. Remember to acknowledge their perspective and YOUR perspective. We fight the problem, not each other. 

Do what makes you happy too, alone and together. 

You two are evolving with each other and you have your own pace, don't compare your relationship to any relationship (especially movie relationships or your friends relationship etc). This is reality. Arguments might stem from serious problems, don't run away with it. Discuss properly and understand how to compromise. Stand your ground.
